```sql
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 
        4
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_logistics__shipments
WHERE carrier = 'Coastal Couriers'
  AND promised_date >= '2025-04-01'
  AND promised_date <= '2026-02-28';
```
